title: JAB Visions Store
summary: The JAB Visions Store is the ecosystem's commerce engine, presenting products as numbered, signal-charged artifacts connected to the wider visual and story language of JAB Visions.
facts: The Store supports the JAB Visions brand, original productions, audience growth, and future artifacts.
Its current public visual language uses neon signal color, auras, energy, crowns, seals, field equipment, and artifact numbering.
Current Board marketplace concepts include fashion, accessories, wearable technology, lighting, patches, jewelry, bags, and audio objects.
Public artifact names visible in the project include the AGENT ADAMS Smartwatch, Field Power Unit, Signal Halo, Wayfarer Pack, Signal Crown Headphones, Aaron Black Seal Pendant, and Divine Femme Top.
Product availability, price, materials, shipping, and return terms must come from the live Store; Visionary AI must not invent or promise them.
Store imagery and concepts should not be promoted to story canon unless an approved record explicitly says they are canon.
